275: 	 * @since	0.4.0
276: 	 */
277: 	public ThumbnailMaker resizerFactory(ResizerFactory resizerFactory) {
278: 		this.resizerFactory = resizerFactory;
279: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZER);
280: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZERFACTORY);
281: 		return this;
282: 	}
283: 	
284: 	/**
285: 	 * Sets the {@link ResizerFactory} to use {@link DefaultResizerFactory}.
286: 	 * 
287: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
288: 	 * @since	0.4.0
289: 	 */
290: 	public ThumbnailMaker defaultResizerFactory() {
291: 		this.resizerFactory = DefaultResizerFactory.getInstance();
292: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZER);
293: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZERFACTORY);
294: 		return this;
295: 	}
296: }
